roster.search: Search by name or employee no.

roster.changeHint: A change for this day only. It comes before every assignment.
roster.precedence: Priority: the day's change, then the employee's, the group's, the department's, the branch's, the company's.
roster.assignmentsHint: Who works which shift or rotation, from when.

devices.connectorsHint: The company's BioTime or BioStar servers. The branch's time zone reads the device times.
devices.tokenOnce: Copy the token now: it won't be shown again. The previous token has stopped working.
devices.tokenUse: Put it in the agent's settings file smarthr-agent.toml (token) or in SMARTHR_TOKEN. The agent sends the punches to /api/v1/attendance/ingest with it.
devices.name: Name
devices.branchHint: Device times are read in this branch's time zone.
devices.usersHint: A device user ID is matched to the employee number automatically. Link the rest; their earlier punches follow.
devices.linkHint: Their punches ({{count}}) move to the employee you choose.
devices.punchesHint: As they arrived from each source. Never changed or deleted; a repeat within a minute counts once.
devices.enterHint: A punch by hand, in the employee's branch time, with the reason. Recorded under your name.
devices.testCounts: Terminals: {{terminals}} · People: {{people}} · Punches in the last day: {{punches}}
devices.samples: Sample punches from the last day
devices.cloudHint: The system reads the punches from the BioTime or BioStar server itself. The server must be reachable from the internet over https; otherwise use the on-site agent.
devices.passwordKept: Kept — leave empty to keep it
devices.verifyTlsOff: Without checking the certificate, someone in between could pose as the server. Use it only with a self-signed certificate you trust.
devices.eventCodesHint: Leave empty for every successful authentication (4096–4111 and 4864–4879). Test connection shows the codes your server logs.
devices.loggedCodes: Event codes logged in the last day:
devices.noTerminals: No terminal has sent a punch yet.
devices.importNote: One row per person: the connection's name, their ID on the device and the employee number (empty = not linked). A person the server hasn't sent yet is added, and their earlier punches move with the link.
devices.mockLocationHint: The phone reported a faked location (a mock-location app). The punch was taken: check it with the employee.

record.hint: Each day is built from the shift, the punches, the approved requests and the holidays, and worked out again when any of them changes.
record.none: No days worked out for this day.

flags.over_workplace_hours: Longer than the day's limit at work

record.monthLocked: This month is locked: its days are as they were locked and aren't built again.

myDay.geofence: Your location is checked: within {{metres}} m of your branch.

excused.remote: Approved remote work today: the branch's location isn't required.
excused.mission: An approved mission now: the branch's location isn't required.

myDay.selfieAsk: Your company asks for a selfie with each check in and out.
myDay.selfieOn: A selfie is taken with each check in and out.

selfie.why: Your company asks for a selfie when you check in or out on the web or the app, to make sure the account's owner made the punch.
selfie.kept: The photo is kept privately and deleted automatically after {{days}} days.
selfie.noMatching: It is never used to recognise or match faces.
selfie.who: Only the HR team in charge of attendance can see it.
selfie.withdraw: You can withdraw your consent at any time; you then punch on the device.
selfie.agreeBox: I have read this and agree
selfie.noCamera: The camera couldn't be opened. Allow the browser to use it and try again.

geofences.hint: In a branch with a geofence, checking in and out on the web needs an accurate location inside the circle; outside is refused unless approved remote work or a mission covers it.
geofences.dialogHint: Set the branch's centre and radius. The easiest way: open this page inside the branch and press "My location".
geofences.locateFailed: Your location couldn't be found. Allow the browser to use it.

syncLog.title: Sync log
syncLog.hint: Every read of the device servers and every batch from an agent: what came, and why a read failed.

correction.replaces_other: It takes the place of {{count}} device punches.
correction.replaces_zero: The time is added to the day's punches.

overtimeRequest.hint: Time outside your shift on that day: before or after it, or a rest day or public holiday. Overtime counts only once approved.
overtimeRequest.yearLeft: {{hours}} hours left this year after it

months.title: Attendance months
months.hint: Payroll locks a month once it has ended: its days are built a last time and don't change afterwards. Opening a locked month needs a reason; locking and opening are in the audit log.
months.lockExplain: The month's days are built for everyone a last time, then it is locked: no hand-entered punches, roster changes, corrections or overtime requests for its days are taken; late device punches are kept without changing its days.
months.unlockExplain: The month can be changed again and its days are built again on any change. Write why; it goes to the audit log.
months.pendingLeft_one: 1 request of this month is still waiting: it can't be approved while the month is locked.
months.pendingLeft_other: {{count}} requests of this month are still waiting: they can't be approved while the month is locked.

attendanceReports.title: Attendance reports
attendanceReports.hint: The same rows on the screen and in the Excel file; every export is in the audit log.

employeeMonth.title: Attendance this month
employeeMonth.hint: Each day as it was built from the shift, the punches and the approved requests.

rules.hint: Company practice, not the law: the daily wage divisor, how days are counted, rounding, pay day and advance rules. Each company may change them.

fields.gosi_partial_month: GOSI for a joiner or leaver

fields.full_award_after_childbirth_months: Full award: a woman resigning within (months) of childbirth

components.name: Component

structures.hint: Which components an employee gets and the amount or formula of each. An employee's structure is their own, else their grade's, else the default.
structures.name: Structure
structures.gradesHint: Used for employees of these grades unless they have their own.
structures.linesHint: Contract components take the employee's contract amounts; enter fixed amounts here, and formulas may be changed for this structure.
structures.amountHint: Leave blank to set it per employee.
structures.formulaOverride: Formula in this structure (blank = the component's)

from.contract: The amount comes from the employee's contract.
from.percent: A percent of another component, as set on the component.

employeePay.title: Monthly salary components
employeePay.hint: The month's fixed amounts. Attendance, inputs and deductions are added when payroll runs.
employeePay.ownHint: Recurring amounts for this employee for a period, such as a phone allowance.

payCalc.title: The month's calculation
payCalc.hint: What the employee is owed this month so far: the days paid, each line and how it is worked out, leave below full pay and leave pay in advance. Attendance and GOSI join as they are built.
payCalc.proposalsHint: From the working-hours penalty table. Deducted only by a disciplinary decision after the employee is told and heard (Art. 71).
payCalc.carriedHint: The Labor Law's limits on deducting from the wage due ({{wage}}): Art. 66 and 92.

reasons.art92_advance: An installment above its share of the wage (Art. 92)
reasons.art92_total: Deductions above their share of the wage (Art. 92)

penalties.title: Working-hours violations
penalties.hint: The violations and penalties table of the model internal work regulation (MHRSD). Penalties are a share of the daily wage.
penalties.levelAccount: This is the account's table, used by every company. Take a copy for this company to change it.
penalties.levelCompany: This company uses its own copy of the table.
penalties.art71: The payroll deducts only the wage of the time lost on the rows that say so; penalties are proposed and deducted only by a disciplinary decision (Art. 71).
penalties.delaysOthersLong: Only when it delayed other workers (never applied automatically)
penalties.deductTime: Plus the wage of the time lost

types.days_or_hold_one: {{value}} day's wage or no promotion / increment once
types.days_or_hold_other: {{value}} days' wage or no promotion / increment once

typeNames.percent: A share of the daily wage

gosi.fileHint: The first registration decides the rate; the contribution wage is what was reported to GOSI.
gosi.firstRegisteredHint: With any employer. Empty = this employer's registration or the hire date.
gosi.housingInKind: Housing in kind (given by the employer)

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy policy
privacyPolicy.subtitle: SSS HR System: the website and the mobile app

who.title: Who we are
who.body: SSS HR System is provided by Saudi Smart HR Solutions (شركة الحلول الذكية للموارد البشرية) to companies for managing their employees. Your employer chose the system and decides what it holds about you: under the Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL) your employer is the controller of your data, and we process it on your employer's behalf and on its instructions.

collect.title: What the app collects
collect.body:
- Your work e-mail and password, to sign you in. The password is never kept on the phone.
- What you send: requests (leave, permissions, missions, letters, advances, expenses and others), their reasons and comments, and the files you attach, such as a receipt or a medical report.
- Your location, only at the moment you check in or out, so your branch can confirm where you are. Never in the background.
- A selfie, only when your company asks for one at check-in, taken with the front camera.
- About the phone: its model, its system version, the app's version, a random number the app makes for this phone, and its push address, so you can see and sign out your phones and receive notifications.
- Error reports, without your name, e-mail, files or anything you typed, to find and fix faults.

not.title: What the app does not do
not.body:
- No advertising, no tracking across apps or websites, and no selling or renting of data.
- Face ID and fingerprints stay on the phone: the app only learns whether the check succeeded.
- No access to your contacts, messages or other apps' data.

why.title: Why
why.body: Only to provide the HR services your employer uses: your attendance, leave and requests, their approvals, your payslips, letters and documents, and the company's announcements and events. The legal basis is your employment contract and your employer's legal obligations under the Labor Law and related regulations.

who_sees.title: Who sees it
who_sees.body:
- Your employer: the people its settings allow, such as your manager, the approvers of your requests and the HR team.
- Our staff, only to keep the system running or when your employer asks for support, which is recorded in the audit log.
- Service providers we use to run the system: Google Firebase to deliver notifications (it receives the phone's push address and the notification) and Sentry for error reports (without personal data). These providers may process data outside the Kingdom; this is done only as the PDPL and its regulations on transfers allow.
- Authorities, only when a law requires it.

keep.title: How long it is kept
keep.body: As long as your employer keeps it, following its retention rules and the periods the law requires (for example payroll and attendance records). On the phone, the app keeps a copy of what it last loaded so it opens without a connection; it is encrypted and deleted when you sign out.

security.title: How it is protected
security.body: Every connection is encrypted (HTTPS). Each company's data is kept apart from every other company's. Sign-in keys are kept in the phone's secure storage, and files open only through short-lived links after a permission check. Screens with pay and documents are hidden from the app switcher.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: Under the PDPL you can ask to know what is held about you, to receive a copy, to have it corrected, and to have it deleted when it is no longer needed. Since your employer controls your data, ask your HR team first; you can also write to us and we will pass your request to your employer and help it answer.

changes.title: Changes
changes.body: When this policy changes, the date at the top changes too. An important change is announced in the app.
